quotes.title: TOI-5788
quotes.card: TOI-5788 is a metal-poor yellow dwarf of spectral class G4, located approximately 318 light-years away from us in the zodiacal constellation Lyra.
quotes.introduction: Its apparent visual magnitude is 10.15, making it invisible to the naked eye but observable with a standard telescope.
